Current.definition: Current minus Predictive within the same repeat block

Hybrid.definition: Hybrid minus Predictive within the same repeat block

limitations: Three observations per mode; descriptive means and sample SD only, no significance claim.
Pairing is by rotating repeat block, not simultaneous requests or randomized assignment.
HTTP metrics include requests draining after offered load end; success-only latency conditions on HTTP 200 and expected response.
Replica occupancy uses 15-second status samples held until the next sample, not CPU usage or billing.
A successful Scale write precedes Pod readiness; its direction uses the previous desired replica count.
Null timings remain missing with explicit sample counts; every run and extraction warning is retained.
